sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
Furoji: Calm Center may not be the biggest [[Titan]] around, but its power is deceptively strong. Battles often come down to who has the most Combat Actions or the most heroes, and the extra card you draw with Furoji can give you a serious edge. That card can also be used for discard costs, making it easier to play with heroes like [[TCG:SAS-007|Igantius: Walking Volcano]] or [[TCG:SAS-001|Caliban: Dante's Titan]].
